name: Hawaiian Airlines® World Elite Business Mastercard®

localized_names.en: Hawaiian Airlines® World Elite Business Mastercard®

apr.notes: For purchases and balance transfers, the variable APR is 19.49% to 29.49%. The variable APR for cash advances is 29.74%. APRs vary with the market based on the Prime Rate. Minimum monthly interest charge $1.00. Balance transfer fee: 3% (min. $5). Cash advance fee: 3% (min. $10).

fx_fee.notes: Disclosure states 'Foreign transaction fee: 0%.' Page also states 'No foreign transaction fees means you don't pay additional transaction fees on international purchases.'

categories.label: 3x Points on eligible Hawaiian Airlines and Alaska Airlines purchases
2x Points on gas, dining, and office supply store purchases

rewards.redemption_notes: No limit to the total Atmos Rewards points you can earn as long as the program continues and your account remains open and in good standing. Atmos Rewards points never expire.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 50,000 Atmos™ Rewards points after spending $4,000 on purchases and paying the annual fee in full, both within the first 90 days

benefits.title: 50%-Off Companion Discount
benefits.description: Receive a one-time 50%-off companion discount for roundtrip coach travel between Hawaii and North America destinations on Hawaiian Airlines operated flights or roundtrip North America coach travel on Alaska Airlines operated flights.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees means you don't pay additional transaction fees on international purchases.

benefits.title: Unlimited Points
benefits.description: No limit to the total Atmos Rewards points you can earn as long as the program continues, and your account remains open and in good standing.

benefits.title: Points Never Expire
benefits.description: Atmos Rewards points never expire, so you can redeem them anytime.

benefits.title: Expense Tracking
benefits.description: Receive a consolidated statement showing all expenses for easier expense tracking.

benefits.title: Employee Cards
benefits.description: Complimentary employee cards at no additional fee – employee cards help earn rewards faster and control business spending.

notes: All key facts verified from fetched issuer page including annual fee $99, APR 19.49%-29.49% variable, cash advance 29.74%, FX fee 0%, signup bonus 50,000 points after $4,000 spend + annual fee in 90 days.
